assignmentTitle: Analysis of C-Clamp Screw and Collar Friction Effects

criteria.title: Understand the C-Clamp Power-Screw Application
criteria.description: Understanding the C-clamp engineering context: sliding handle rotation drives power screw, helical threads transmit axial force, pressure pad clamps workpiece, and tightening torque overcomes both thread friction and collar friction.

criteria.title: Identify C-Clamp Components and Mechanical Functions
criteria.description: Accurate identification of Fixed Upper Anvil, Workpiece, Rigid C-Clamp Frame, Movable Pressure Pad, Power Screw, Screw Thread, Threaded Engagement, Collar Friction Interface, Screw Head, and Sliding Handle on Engineering Asset EA-19.

criteria.title: Understand the Power-Screw Load and Motion Path
criteria.description: Correctly sequencing the mechanical load path: Handle Rotation → Power Screw Rotation → Thread Interaction → Axial Screw Movement → Pressure Pad Movement → Clamping Force on Workpiece.

criteria.title: Establish Design Data and Engineering Assumptions
criteria.description: Correct identification of given design data: W = 5,000 N, d = 22 mm, p = 5 mm, two-start thread (n = 2, L = 10 mm), μ = 0.15, dc = 28 mm, μc = 0.10, R = 120 mm.

criteria.title: Determine Screw Geometry and Helix Angle
criteria.description: Accurate calculation of mean diameter dm = d − p/2 = 19.5 mm, lead L = 2p = 10 mm, and helix angle tan α = L / (π dm) giving α ≈ 9.27° with correct units and working.

criteria.title: Calculate Thread Friction Torque
criteria.description: Correct calculation of thread friction angle φ = tan⁻¹(μ) ≈ 8.53° and thread friction torque T_s = (W dm / 2) [(μ + tan α) / (1 − μ tan α)] ≈ 15,654 N·mm.

criteria.title: Calculate Collar Friction Torque
criteria.description: Correct application of collar friction torque relation T_c = μc W dc / 2 = 0.10 × 5,000 × (28 / 2) = 7,000 N·mm with clear physical understanding of thrust interface losses.

criteria.title: Determine Total Tightening Torque and Operator Hand Force
criteria.description: Accurate determination of total tightening torque T_total = T_s + T_c ≈ 22,654 N·mm (22.65 N·m) and required hand force F = T_total / R ≈ 188.8 N.

criteria.title: Analyse the Relative Effect and Significance of Collar Friction
criteria.description: Detailed comparative analysis demonstrating that collar friction increases required torque by ~44.7% over thread friction alone and accounts for ~30.9% of total tightening torque.

criteria.title: Engineering Judgement — C-Clamp Design Evaluation
criteria.description: Technically justified engineering evaluation of the C-clamp power screw design, addressing collar lubrication, handle length, self-locking, and efficiency improvements.

criteria.title: C-Clamp Power Screw Analysis and Design Report
criteria.description: Concise, structured engineering report synthesizing all 10 key technical parameters and engineering conclusions for the EA-19 C-clamp power-screw analysis.
